annotations.target_phrase: Dark hair, mirrored glasses, dark clothing, slender...
annotations.annotation_text: The first visual appearance of Molly Millions (the 'razor girl'). Her mirrored lenses reflect the visual grammar of the 1980s cyberpunk movement, functioning as both tactical prosthetics and psychological masks.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 16.
Sterling, Bruce. Mirrorshades: The Cyberpunk Anthology. Arbor House, 1986.

annotations.target_phrase: Taser. One hour, twenty New Yen. Thirty deposit.
annotations.annotation_text: The rental economy of black-market weaponry in Chiba, showcasing Gibson's meticulous attention to the micro-economics of street crime and temporary tactical equipment.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 16.
